info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Consumer Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Consumer Advisory Services Update API enables businesses to modify existing consumer advisory services by specifying a unique parameter. This functionality allows for tailored updates to advisory offerings, empowering financial institutions to better serve their clients with personalized recommendations. Typical users of this API include banking application developers and integrations that require dynamic adjustments to advisory content. By utilizing this API, organizations can efficiently manage and enhance consumer interactions, ensuring they meet evolving client needs.

patch.description: This operation allows for the modification of existing consumer advisory services identified by a specific resource reference. It provides the ability to make changes to various attributes, ensuring that the service remains up-to-date with current standards and consumer requirements.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to patch the specified consumer advisory service identified by RES-100045. It includes the fields that need to be updated for the consumer advisory service. Please ensure that all required fields are included in the request.
